data.one_liner: A small library to draw dashed lines in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dash widget that allows developers to draw horizontal or customized dashed lines in their Flutter applications. Users can configure parameters such as direction, length, dash length, thickness, color, border radius, and gap.
use_when: You need to draw a dashed line or divider in a Flutter UI
You want to customize dash color, thickness, and spacing without writing custom painting code
avoid_when: You need complex vector graphics or charts
You require advanced path manipulations not supported by the basic parameters
strengths: Configurable properties like direction, length, dash thickness, and gaps
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing only on dashed lines
Not documented for advanced use cases beyond basic parameters
data.setup_notes: Just add flutter_dash as a dependency in your pubspec.yaml file.
data.minimal_example:
Dash(
  direction: Axis.horizontal,
  length: 132,
  dashLength: 12,
  dashColor: Colors.red
)
